name: Watson Bio 24 well
author: Ramona Optics
notes: Dimensions from the official WATSON Bio Lab microplate dimensions chart (EN_MicroPlate_DimensionTable.pdf), '24 well flat bottom' row (197-24CPS with lid / 196-24FS without lid). Units in meters. Well spacing (pitch) 18 mm. Plate body height 20.5 mm (23.1 mm including lid). Well depth 17.5 mm; well top diameter 15.5 mm (bottom diameter 15.1 mm); flat chimney-well design. A1 well center is 18.5 mm from the left edge and 15.4 mm from the top edge. Use 'pitch' and origin reference to compute all well centers.
